Ils peuvent être retirés jusqu’à la date limite de remise des plis. SECTION III - DEROULEMENT DE LA CONSULTATION 1. DUME Bien que son utilisation ne soit pas obligatoire, l’Ined encourage fortement les candidats à renseigner un Document Unique de Marché Européen (DUME) pour candidater. 1.1. Qu’est-ce que le DUME Le DUME est un formulaire électronique standardisé qui permet à un opérateur économique de présenter sa candidature à un marché public en déclarant son identité, sa situation juridique, financière et ses capacités professionnelles. The Academy’s activities include research programmes, grants and awards, scholarly publications, library and cultural heritage services, public engagement, facilities management and the operation of the Digital Repository of Ireland. Lisa eesmärk Lisa eesmärk on kokku leppida volitatud töötleja õigustes ja kohustuses isikuandmete töötlemisel, millest pooled juhinduvad lepingu täitmisel (edaspidi teenused). Lisa jõustub pärast selle allkirjastamist mõlema poole poolt. Lisa rakendatakse, kui volitatud töötleja töötleb vastutava töötleja nimel vastavalt lepingule kliendi isikuandmeid. Lisa kujutab endast isikuandmete töötlemist puudutavat andmetöötluse lepingut vastavalt Euroopa Liidu isikuandmete kaitse üldmäärusele (EL 2016/679) (edaspidi GDPR). SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

ta export of invoices in .csv or Excel format every month • Internet browsing for wireless handheld devices • Unassigned blank SIM cards for future issuance or replacement, and the ability to provision eSIM-enabled devices on demand • Wi-Fi Calling (Voice over Wi-Fi) • Unrestricted mobile hotspot (tethering) capability without additional charges, separate data allowances, or reduced speeds. • Cellular coverage with sufficient indoor signal strength to support reliable service throughout all office areas within the U.S. Embassy compound The Contractor shall ensure that services provided through its network are delivered with high availability, reliability, voice clarity, and data performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. reliable international voice connectivity on a 24 -hour basis to the United States, Latin America, Europe, and other international destinations where commercially available telecommunications services exist. International calling services shall support clear and reliable voice communications consistent with the best commercial practices for enterprise telecommunications services. INTERNATIONAL ROAMING The Contractor shall provide broad international roaming coverage for voice, SMS, and data services through commercially established roaming agreements with foreign mobile network operators. Emphasis shall be placed on roaming availability and service reliability throughout the Western Hemisphere. The Contractor shall support international roaming services compatible with 4G/LTE services, and/or 5G services (5G services where commercially available). The Contractor shall provide the COR with an updated list of current international roaming partners and supported roaming countries at least every six (6) months. The Contractor shall disclose any significant roaming restrictions, unsupported regions, or service limitations in its proposal. SMS MESSAGING The Contractor shall provide reliable SMS messaging services on a 24- hour basis, including domestic, inter

ns and changes, lost or stolen device r eporting, billing inquiries, and service troubleshooting. The Contractor shall provide dedicated account management and support personnel who are fluent in both English and Spanish. The Contractor shall provide a dedicated customer support email address for the U.S. Embassy Panama. These risks range from personal data being stolen or inadvertently released and used by criminals to impersonate the individual, to worry being caused to individuals that their data will be used by MSLETB for unknown purposes. Es wird erwartet, dass sämtliche Maßnahmen zur Unterstützung der Datenschutzfolgeabschätzung durch den Beauftragten durchgeführt werden. Insbesondere sind die im Verfahrensverzeichnis aufzunehmenden verfahrensbe- zogenen Angaben zur Verfügung zu stellen (vgl. Art. 30 DS-GVO). Daher werden die aktuellen techni- schen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen des Anbieters angefordert. Im Verfahren werden regelmäßig personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet. The Academy’s activities include research programmes, grants and awards, scholarly publications, library and cultural heritage services, public engagement, facilities management and the operation of the Digital Repository of Ireland. The Contractor shall disclose any significant roaming restrictions, unsupported regions, or service limitations in its proposal.
